chunks: And the Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him and his family, said:

"I do not want to find among you a man whose deceased died at night and he waits with him until morning, nor a man whose deceased died during the day and he waits with him until night. Do not wait for the rising of the sun or its setting with your dead. Hasten them to their resting places. May Allah have mercy on you."
So the people said: "And you, O Messenger of Allah, may Allah have mercy on you."
ai.seo_question: Should burial of the deceased be delayed until morning or night in Islam?
ai.summary: This hadith instructs that the burial of the deceased should not be unnecessarily delayed from night to morning or from day to night. It emphasizes hastening the dead to their graves and reflects the Prophetic sunnah (prophetic tradition) concerning prompt funeral rites.
